name: Winamax SA
note: French online poker and sports-betting operator (SIREN 492155932, SA, Paris), founded and owned by its shareholders Alexandre Roos and Christophe Schaming per the company's own 'À propos' page; the registry lists both as dirigeants. Luxembourg vehicle Oxley Properties S.A. also sits on the board, with the same Roos/Schaming leadership behind it. No state or fund stake found.
